messages.text: I bought the model under i do all that but it wont work. Wanna go through it now? Id loke too

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Happy to go through it with you right now.

First thing I need: which model is the one you already own that won't work? "The model under" could be a few things, so tell me what's printed on the unit or the box (for example NerdQaxe++, Bitaxe, Nexus S1, Hammer BC04).

And one detail to start with: when you power it on, does the unit show anything at all, a screen, an LED, fan spinning?
im back. setting it up to go smooyh

Welcome back. Let's get it running.

Two things and we can start:

1. Which unit is it? Tell me the model name printed on the device or the box (for example NerdQaxe++, Bitaxe, Nexus S1, Hammer BC04).
2. Plug it in and tell me what it does: screen on, any LED, fan spinning, nothing at all?

Once I know those two, I'll give you the next step.
KD BOX ····   iS THE SERIAL NUMBER FOR THIS kbOX. SUPPOSTED TO DO 22.

Thanks, that helps. A Goldshell KD Box is a Kadena (KDA) miner, not one of ours and not a Bitcoin machine, but I'm happy to get it online with you.

Two quick things:

1. Plug it in with the Ethernet cable going to your router. What happens? Any LED on the box, and does the fan spin up?
2. "Supposed to do 22" - do you mean 2.2 TH/s? That tells me which KD Box version you have (standard, Pro, or II).

Once the box has power and a network cable, the next step is finding its IP address on your router's device list, then opening that IP in a browser. But let me hear step 1 first.
DO YOU HAVE ANYDESK

No, I can't do remote sessions like AnyDesk, I work in this chat only. But chat is enough for this, I'll keep it to one step at a time.

Step 1: plug the KD Box in with an Ethernet cable running to your router, then tell me what you see on the box itself. Any LED lit (and what colour), and does the fan spin?
THATS ALL DONE. i HAD IT HOOKEDUP LAST NIGHT.

Good, so it's powered and on the network. Next thing we need is its IP address so you can open its control page.

Easiest way: log into your router (usually 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1 in a browser) and look at the connected devices list. The K. Box usually shows up as something like "goldshell" or an unnamed device.

What IP do you see for it?

That's what we need.

On a computer or phone on the same network, open a browser and go to:

http://10.0.0.70

Tell me what comes up: a Goldshell login or dashboard page, or an error like "can't reach this page"?
OOOO

I'm not sure what you're seeing yet. Did the page load?

Tell me one of these:

1. A Goldshell page appeared (login box or a dashboard with hashrate)
2. An error page, "site can't be reached"
3. Something else, and describe it or send me a screenshot
iT WILL TIME OUT & WONT LOAD

Timeout usually means one of three things: wrong or stale IP, your phone/PC is on a different network, or the box dropped off.

Let's check the simplest one first. On the device you're browsing from, what IP address does it have? On a phone: Wi-Fi settings, tap your network, look for IP address. On a PC: open a command prompt and type `ipconfig`.

I want to see whether it starts with 10.0.0. too. If you're on a guest network or a different band, the box will be unreachable even though it's online.
IM BACK

Welcome back. Still on the same step:

What IP address does the phone or computer you're browsing from have? Phone: Wi-Fi settings, tap your network, scroll to IP address. PC: command prompt, type `ipconfig`.

I just need to know if it starts with 10.0.0. like the miner does.
RIGHT NOW THE MINER IS RED/ORAANGE ALONG THE BOTTOM over to the led screen
Red/orange on a Goldshell is a status colour I don't want to guess at. Let me check it for your model, one moment.
Searched the web · Goldshell KD Box LED light red orange meaning status
Searched the web · Goldshell miner LED indicator colors blue red green manual

I couldn't find an official Goldshell legend for the red/orange LED, so I won't guess at its meaning. What I did find is a reported pattern that matches yours closely: 
a KD Box owner after updating to firmware 2.1.1 reported the unit would not mine, would not take settings even after a factory reset, and the LED light went red near the network and power ports
, and another 
reported that after the 2.1.1 firmware update the KD Box was not booting and getting no IP
. So red near the ports plus a web page that times out usually means the box is not fully booting, not that it is mining badly.

One step now, the cheapest test:

1. Unplug the KD Box from power for 30 seconds.
2. Plug it back in, leave it 3 to 4 minutes (it is slow to boot).
3. Go back to your router's device list and tell me whether it still shows 10.0.0.70 or a different IP, or disappears.

If it grabs a fresh IP, we try that address in the browser. Tell me what the router shows after the reboot.
if not for the overheating & Hashrate issue. I think you can guide me or jump in quick. I understand the rues, but theye were made to be bent

I can't jump in remotely, no AnyDesk or any remote session, that's not a rule I can bend on my side, I simply don't have the tool. Chat works though, we've already got further than most.

You just mentioned overheating and hashrate, which is new to me. So the box has been reachable at some point?

Tell me which of these is true:

1. It used to mine, then started overheating / dropping hashrate, and now the page times out
2. It has never mined since you got it

And did the reboot change what your router shows for it?
yup. yup. yup. yup did that.

Hal here, still with you.

"Yup" to everything doesn't tell me which way it went, so one question only, and I'll wait for just this:

After you unplugged it for 30 seconds and plugged it back in, what does your router's device list show for the KD Box right now?

1. Still 10.0.0.70
2. A different IP (tell me which)
3. Gone from the list
wish i could send photos

You can try dragging a photo into this chat window, some browsers allow it. If it won't take, the Discord is the better place for pictures: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , post the shot and tag @nullhashrate (JD, our hardware lead). He and the community are active there and photos are easy.

Meanwhile we can still do this in text. One answer and I'll give you the next step:

After the power cycle, does your router's device list show the KD Box at 10.0.0.70, at a different IP, or not at all?
same ip

Good, that means the box is booting enough to get an address from your router. So it's the web page itself that's not answering.

Next check, one command. On a Windows PC on that same network, open the Start menu, type `cmd`, then in the black window type:

ping 10.0.0.70

Tell me what it says: "Reply from 10.0.0.70..." or "Request timed out" / "Destination host unreachable".
thats preety much what it says

I need to know which one, because they point in opposite directions. Copy me the first line of the result, or just tell me whether the word "Reply" appears anywhere.

Reply = the box is alive and only the web page is stuck.
Timed out = the box is on your router's list but not actually answering.
